Class AhpHost

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.AhpHost
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
@CopilotExperimental public final class AhpHost extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A ready, connection-owned AHP listener. The handle remains bound to its original transport across client reconnects. Disposal never deletes application sessions.

    • unpublishSession

      public CompletableFuture<HostUnpublishSessionResult> unpublishSession(String sessionId)
      Withdraws a live or dormant application publication and revokes AHP attachments. Preserves local history, worktrees and ongoing work. Rejects nonapplication publications without stopping the host.
      Parameters:
      sessionId - canonical application session identity
      Returns:
      whether a publication was removed; false when already absent
